ACT II OF 1991
ACT II OF 1991
CRIMINAL LAW (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the
Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 28th March, 1991.]
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), and the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

Amendment of section 365-A, Act XLV of 1860

ACT II OF 1991
ACT II OF 1991
CRIMINAL LAW (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the
Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 28th March, 1991.]
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), and the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of section 365-A, Act XLV of 1860.--In the Pakistan
Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), in section 365-A, after the words "punished
with", the words "death or" shall be inserted.

sections.description:
Amendment of second schedule, Act V of 1898

ACT II OF 1991
ACT II OF 1991
CRIMINAL LAW (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the
Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 28th March, 1991.]
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), and the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
3. Amendment of second schedule, Act V of 1898.--In the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), in the second schedule, in the entry
in column 7 relating to section 365-A, for the word "Imprisonment"
the words "Death or imprisonment" shall be substituted.
